description: On the bed in front of you, there’s a small white eyeglasses case near the center and a dark blue pillow at the back. Both hands move forward to grasp the case as a two-hand object, then the left hand steadies it while the right hand lifts the flap open; the right hand reaches inside, pinches and pulls out a pair of glasses as a right-hand object, and holds them up while the left hand lets the case rest open on the bed.
